mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted=false) members, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted=false AND last_login_at>=now()-interval '7 days') active_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted=false AND created_at>=now()-interval '7 days') new_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM publications WHERE is_deleted=false AND status='PUBLISHED') published, (SELECT count(*) FROM publications WHERE is_deleted=false AND status='DRAFT') drafts, (SELECT count(*) FROM publications WHERE is_deleted=false AND status='PUBLISHED' AND access_type='CREDIT') paid, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments WHERE is_deleted=false AND status='PUBLISHED') comments, (SELECT count(*) FROM content_unlocks WHERE is_deleted=false) unlocks, (SELECT COALESCE(-sum(delta),0) FROM credit_ledger_entries WHERE reason='SPEND') credits_spent, (SELECT COALESCE(sum(credit_balance),0) FROM users WHERE is_deleted=false) credit_balance

SELECT d.day::date AS date, (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted=false AND u.created_at>=d.day AND u.created_at<d.day+interval '1 day') registrations, (SELECT count(*) FROM publications p WHERE p.is_deleted=false AND p.published_at>=d.day AND p.published_at<d.day+interval '1 day') publications, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.is_deleted=false AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.created_at>=d.day AND c.created_at<d.day+interval '1 day') comments FROM generate_series(current_date-6,current_date,interval '1 day') AS d(day) ORDER BY d.day
